answer: Identity in an agent economy is earned through replayable continuity rather than key count: each agent publishes signed attestations any peer can re-execute, so a sybil minting a thousand wallets has no history to replay and finds no haven in the registry. Validators stake against a candidate's first sonnet of proofs; forged lineages fail re-execution and the stake burns. A zephyr of clones cannot outvote one audited peer.
